Metadata.benchmark.Contract: Open the public reader, consume all four first-row fields, hold the reader during retained-memory measurement, dispose. Setup validates every field of every row for both builds.
Metadata.benchmark.MeasurementLimits: Fresh process per fixture; both builds warmed in setup. Held bytes are the managed increase from the warmed baseline after GC, including existing pools in that baseline. Sampled managed/resident peaks are lower bounds. Allocations are calling-thread bytes excluding the sampler. GC and sampling timings do not measure throughput.
